chapter: Rising in Manhattan: clubs, Hilda and the Latin scene
title: Chateau Madrid, La Conga and the Beachcomber
summary: They won over the Chateau Madrid, filled in for Sacasas at La Conga, and played the Beachcomber.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So we worked one day out there, two days, the off-day of the one day and the other band. So we got there and killed everybody. That was a típica thing. They was playing by ear, practically, "Perfidia" and "Ojos Negros", you know, na na na na na.

All stocks. So went up there with a special arrangement - there was like a day and night - so the owner of La Conga, Jack Harris, a musician, he heard about us and Sacasas was playing at the La Conga. He was the main band up there for dancing and Jack Harris had his band to play for the show, so one day Sacasas feel like go to see his family to Santiago de Cuba and he took two weeks. So he give me the two weeks to replace Sacasas.

Sacasas send me a telegram that he going to be another four weeks because his mother, the aunt or whatever and he got fed-up with the independence of, you know the owners are, and he liked what we were doing, because he was a musician. We couldn't fool the guy, a tremendous violin player, so he liked the band, so we played that particular time and Lopez had a contract for me for six weeks because

he gave it two-weeks notice to the band that he has, So I had the contract in my pocket and I went to Lopez and Lopez said: "no because - come tomorrow to sign the papers because" so and so and so, you know. I feel like so kind of leary about it - that he was hesitant to sign - so I went to La Conga, to Jack Harris, to visit him. He said: "Well, what you have in mind"? I said: "well, we like to work here." So "No, I have Noro Morales. But don't worry. One day, I'll get you. So Noro Morales was a soft-touch colored musician and he was disgusted with the musicians that Noro Morales has. It was a few people qualified to play with Noro, because he was a good musician and he always got a good band. That was a good band, always. So one day, Noro Morales decide to go to the Stork Club and he went to get us.

Before we play La Conga, we played the Beachcomber, where the Hawaii Kai is, and we were the talk of the town. Diosa used to go out there everyday and then she married with Pupi Campo and we, we got together. She helped me tremendously.
